cards.name: Investment Goblin
cards.desc: next x-cost cart triggers 1 more time
cards.note: No mechanism exists to modify a future card play (no 'next card' buff/hook), and it depends on X-cost cards, which aren't functional either (cost 'X' parses to NaN — see 'Rat de Jade'/'cat pack'). Left empty.

cards.name: Feed the troops
cards.desc: give one creature +1/+1 times pour ce tour
cards.note: Depends on an X-cost value (cost 'X' parses to NaN, no dynamic-amount support anywhere) AND a 'this turn only' temporary buff (BuffEffect is permanent, no duration/expiry system). Left empty.

cards.name: Mafia boss
cards.desc: gain X+X with X ally creature that you control
cards.note: No formula/count-based scaling effect exists (BuffEffect only applies a fixed amount, there's no 'count your minions and buff by that much'). The description text is also garbled/ambiguous about the exact intended formula. Left empty.

cards.name: baby hyena
cards.desc: +1/1 whenever another ally creature dies
cards.note: No 'observe any other allied minion dying' trigger exists — deathrattle only fires for the dying minion's own ability, nothing lets a different minion react to it. Left empty.

cards.name: equal opportiny
cards.desc: draw an amount of card equal to your opponents
cards.note: DrawCardEffect only supports a fixed amount, no dynamic 'equal to opponent's hand size' formula. Left empty.

cards.name: cat pack
cards.desc: summon X 2/1 cats
cards.note: No X-cost/dynamic-amount mechanic exists (cost 'X' parses to NaN; SummonMinionEffect needs a fixed 'amount'). Left empty.

cards.name: deep water demon
cards.desc: gain +1/+1 if this is the only minion on your side of the board
cards.note: No conditional/board-state-check effect kind exists to express 'only if this is your one minion'. Left empty.

cards.name: call the kraken
cards.desc: deal 3 dmg to all minions heal you 1 HP for each minons that dies
cards.note: Compound effect: 'deal 3 to all minions' maps cleanly to the 'allMinions' resolver, but 'heal 1 per minion that dies' is a dynamic/reactive amount based on this effect's own outcome, which HealEffect (fixed amount only) can't express. Left the whole thing empty rather than shipping only the damage half.

cards.name: Roi des rats
cards.desc:
LEG PASSIVE: 
half your mana left over is carry to your next turn
Active : 
Your X-card trigger once more.
cards.note: cardLoader.ts now reads legendId as a legendaryPassive slot (resolveLegendaryPassive), but that only recognizes the 4 implemented types (jeffe/timmy/archimede/freddy) — 'Roi des rats' isn't one of them, so there's nothing valid to put here. No mana-carryover logic exists in Player either way (gainMana/spendMana always reset to maxMana), no hero-power/'Active' ability system exists, and it depends on X-cost cards, which aren't functional. Left empty.

cards.name: Le Phoenix
cards.desc:
ruee
rale d'agonie : invoque un phoenix avec des stats -1/-1
cards.note: Implemented only one level of the -1/-1 chain (a single 3/3 token with no further deathrattle). The source text could be read as recursively continuing to lose stats each time it dies, but I didn't attempt to hardcode a multi-level chain — uncertain if that's the intended design.

cards.name: podophile
cards.desc: rend 3 PV
cards.note: Ambiguous target (presumably your own hero), and there is no self/own-hero target resolver anywhere in target.ts. Left empty.

cards.name: Gertrude
cards.desc:
Passif : récompenses de quetes boostées

toujours compter le chiffre le plus élèvé pour les quetes
cards.note: legendId is now readable as a legendaryPassive slot (resolveLegendaryPassive in cardLoader.ts), but it only recognizes the 4 implemented types (jeffe/timmy/archimede/freddy) — 'Gertrude' isn't one of them, so there's nothing valid to set. No quest system exists anywhere in the engine either way (no quest tracking, no quest rewards) — this passive has zero implementation, not just a missing wiring path. Left empty.

cards.name: Banquier Renart le goblin
cards.desc: Quand vous jouez une carte X, inflige X dégats au hasard au ennemis
cards.note: No 'whenever you play any card' observer trigger exists — only battlecry/deathrattle/onAttack/onDamage/turn-start/turn-end hooks exist, none fire on generic card-play events. Also depends on a dynamic X-equals-mana-cost value, which isn't supported anywhere. Left empty.

cards.name: Feeder goblin
cards.desc: Donne +1/+1 a chaque creature invoquée
cards.note: Continuous effect that needs to apply to future summon events; no aura/persistent-modifier system exists. Left empty.

cards.name: Rat de Jade
cards.note: cost/atk/def are all the literal placeholder 'X' — cardLoader.ts parses these with unary '+', which turns 'X' into NaN for all three. No X-cost/dynamic-stat mechanic exists anywhere in the engine, so this card is fundamentally non-functional as seeded, regardless of effect fields.

cards.name: Cavalier furieux
cards.desc: Choisis deux ennemis a attaquer, l'adversaire choisit qui le cavalier attaque
cards.note: No such combat mechanic exists — attackWithMinion only supports a single, attacker-chosen target; there's no 'attacker picks 2, defender resolves which one' flow anywhere in gameEngine.ts or gameSession.ts. Left empty.

cards.name: Slime orthophoniste
cards.desc: Aventurier
cards.note: 'Aventurier' looks like a tribal/quest tag (relevant to Gertrude's unimplemented quest passive) rather than a standalone effect. The engine has no tribe/subtype tagging system at all, so there's nothing to encode here even structurally.

cards.name: Spiritueux slave
cards.desc: Inflige 1 point de dégats et donne +2 atq a une créature pour ce tour
cards.note: Compound: 'deal 1 damage' is easy, but 'give +2 attack to a creature for this turn only' needs a temporary/expiring buff, and BuffEffect is permanent with no duration system — implementing it as a permanent buff would misrepresent the card. Left the whole thing empty rather than shipping only the damage half.

cards.name: Entartrage
cards.desc: Endors une créature pour 1 tour
cards.note: No sleep/freeze/stun status exists anywhere — Keywords has no such flag, and startTurn() unconditionally resets every minion's canAttack to true with no override check. Left empty.

cards.name: Mixeur
cards.desc: Défausse ta main, pioche 3 cartes
cards.note: Compound: 'draw 3 cards' is trivial, but there is no discard-hand mechanic anywhere — Hand only supports add/play/size/isEmpty/getCards, nothing to clear or discard specific cards. Implementing only the draw would make this strictly better than intended (card advantage with no cost), so left empty instead.

cards.name: Cactus dos Pimentos
cards.desc:
Taunt
gagne +1/+1 pour chaque serviteur allié blessé
cards.note: Taunt is set. 'gains +1/+1 per damaged allied minion' needs dynamic/count-based scaling that doesn't exist — BuffEffect only applies a fixed, pre-determined amount, there's no mechanism to count matching board state and scale a buff by it.

cards.name: Buffet à volonté
cards.desc: Quand cette carte subit des dégats, défausse une carte et pioche
cards.note: onDamage timing is supported, but 'discard a card' has no implementation anywhere (same gap as 'Mixeur' — Hand has no discard/remove-by-choice method). Left empty rather than shipping only the draw half.

cards.name: Bondisseur enjoué
cards.desc: Aventurier
cards.note: Same 'Aventurier' tribal/quest-tag note as 'Slime orthophoniste' — no tribe system exists.

cards.name: Flambeur de Dancefloor
cards.desc: Aventurier
cards.note: Same 'Aventurier' tribal/quest-tag note as 'Slime orthophoniste' — no tribe system exists.

cards.name: Sauce TomAAAAAAte
cards.desc: inflige 1 dgts à tout le monde, pioche 1 pour chaque créature décédée
cards.note: Compound: 'deal 1 damage to everyone' maps cleanly to the 'allCharacters' resolver, but 'draw 1 per creature that died' needs a dynamic/reactive amount based on this effect's own outcome, which DrawCardEffect (fixed amount only) can't express. Left the whole spellEffect empty rather than shipping only the damage half.

cards.name: Voxotron exterminateur
cards.desc: Trample
cards.note: 'Trample' (excess combat damage carries over to the hero) isn't implemented — attackWithMinion applies the fixed attacker.attack to whichever single target was chosen, with no overflow-to-hero logic when the target dies from less damage than dealt. Left empty (no keyword/flag exists to set anyway).

cards.name: Leon, le chien saucisse
cards.desc: leg passif : inflige 5 PV a l'hero adverse
cards.note: The 'type' field is the literal string '2', which looks like a data-entry typo (probably meant 'Créature'); it happens to be harmless since only an exact 'sort' match matters for Spell/Minion selection. legendId is now readable as a legendaryPassive slot, but it only recognizes the 4 implemented types (jeffe/timmy/archimede/freddy) — 'Leon' isn't one of them, so there's nothing valid to set. It's also ambiguous whether 'inflige 5 PV a l'hero adverse' is meant as a one-time on-play trigger or a repeating passive — since the text explicitly frames it as a 'leg passif' I didn't want to silently reinterpret it as a plain battlecry. Left empty.
